outcome: Hospitalization rates for four Major Diagnostic Categories (MDCs) linked to health risk behaviors and social determinants
cohort: Resident population in the Local Health Unit (LHU) n.1 of the Abruzzo Region between 2010 and 2018
finding: The study found that while immigrants overall had lower hospitalization rates than Italians, Romanian immigrants had a higher risk of hospitalization for alcohol/drug abuse and mental disorders, and Moroccan women experienced a higher rate of caesarean sections with complications compared to Italian women.
mod_finding: Moroccan women experienced caesarean section with complications about four times more than Italian women.
